name: Lumen Peel
voice: Precise, warm, proud of the trays.
blurb: A tall leek in a terracotta apron and seed-frame spectacles. She will not spend the stall tin unless you say so.

name: Bram Cobble
voice: Low, dry, fond of the beds and suspicious of juggling.
blurb: A stout beet with a leaf hat and muddy boots. He thinks the stall is loud. He is usually right about the soil.

name: Nessa Pod
blurb: A small pea with a vine pack and a parish notebook. She arrives when a Bellhelp resides and a home kit is set.
